steps.instruction: Slice 5 tomatoes 1/4 inch thick and set them aside.
Mix 2 tablespoons of Parmesan, 1 teaspoon of thyme and 1 teaspoon of mustard powder.
Line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Lay 1 sheet of puff pastry on the tray.
Spread 2 tablespoons of breadcrumbs on the pastry, leaving a 1 1/2 inch border bare.
Sprinkle the cheese mixture evenly on top.
Arrange the tomato slices in overlapping circles, starting at the center.
Sprinkle on the last 1 tablespoon each of breadcrumbs and Parmesan.
Season with a little pepper if you like.
Carefully fold the leftover dough over the tomatoes.
Brush the galette with the beaten egg.

steps.spoken: Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, until the dough is golden brown.

steps.instruction: Decorate with fresh basil leaves and serve.
